proposed.text: Under the Guidelines on Building Bulk, what is the relationship between TGFA and GFA?

options.text: TGFA = GFA − Non-GFA areas, excluding certain utility spaces
TGFA = GFA + Non-GFA areas (parking decks, utility rooms, over-10 sqm balconies)
TGFA = GFA × Number of Floors, assuming uniform floor area distribution
TGFA and GFA are synonymous terms used interchangeably in PD 1096, though context may vary
